WITH bowler_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bowler,
        COUNT(*) as balls_bowled
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
wickets AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bowler,
        COUNT(*) as wickets_taken
    FROM wicket_taken w
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON w.match_id = b.match_id 
        AND w.over_id = b.over_id 
        AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id
        AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL AND w.kind_out != 'run out'
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
runs_conceded AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bowler,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) as runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bowler,
        w.match_id,
        COUNT(*) as match_wickets
    FROM wicket_taken w
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON w.match_id = b.match_id 
        AND w.over_id = b.over_id 
        AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id
        AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL AND w.kind_out != 'run out'
    GROUP BY b.bowler, w.match_id
),
bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bowler,
        b.match_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) as match_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.bowler, b.match_id
),
best_matches AS (
    SELECT 
        bw.bowler,
        bw.match_id,
        bw.match_wickets,
        br.match_runs,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bw.bowler ORDER BY bw.match_wickets DESC, br.match_runs ASC) as rn
    FROM bowler_wickets bw
    JOIN bowler_runs br ON bw.bowler = br.bowler AND bw.match_id = br.match_id
),
best_match AS (
    SELECT bowler, match_wickets, match_runs
    FROM best_matches
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_bowlers
FROM bowler_stats bs
LEFT JOIN wickets w ON bs.bowler = w.bowler
LEFT JOIN runs_conceded rc ON bs.bowler = rc.bowler
